paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.89% on average, with DAX strongest (+2.85%) and Nasdaq weakest (-3.06%). Brent crude changed -17.96% to 94.61. Gold changed +0.47% to 4,070.7. Bitcoin changed +3.87% to 80,185.5781. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.894%, a relative move of -2.99%. Among the firms tracked, US Oil Fund (ETF) (-12.70%) and 3i Group (+11.76%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: Menopause specialist sold in €2.6bn private equity deal (FT Markets). Carlyle and PAI Partners agree to sell women’s health business for almost double what they paid four years ago Deals and capital markets: CD&R pursues buyout of $40bn card processor Global Payments (FT Markets).
